items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 43:1
items.html: After the seven kings fell front and back to BYA, also the place of BYA expanded to front and back — that is, to the place of HBD HGT up to the Chazeh, where a place was made for the vessels of the face [Panim]. And from the Chazeh and below, which are the TNHYM, they became a place for the aspect of the Achoraim [posteriors]. Therefore the boundary of the Parsa descended to the place of the Chazeh of the whole of BYA, which is now the aspect of the Chazeh of Yetzirah; and up to there at least the aspects of the holiness of BYA could spread. But from there and below, which is the place of the Achoraim, an empty void also now necessarily remained, and it became a permanent place for the Klipot. See above, answer 103. (Item 97).
